## cssUrl(url)

Wraps a URL in a CSS url() value, escaping double quotes.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `String` | Image URL or data URI. |

**Returns:** `String` - e.g. 'url("/images/bar.webp")'

## optionalCssUrl(url)

Value for an element-level --cork-image-* override, for use with Lit's styleMap. Images come from those
custom properties (see setImageCssCustomProperties); an unset override returns undefined, which styleMap leaves out,
so the document's value applies.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `String` | Override image URL, if any. |

**Returns:** `String\|undefined` - e.g. 'url("/images/bar.webp")', or undefined if no URL.

## setImageCssCustomProperties(host, opts)

Points the theme's large images at a host or directory, by setting each --cork-image-* custom css property.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `String` | Base URL of the images, e.g. '/images/cork-theme' or 'https://cdn.example.edu/images'. Holds the files copied by `npx cork-theme copy-images`. |
| `opts` | `Object` | Options. |
| `opts.root` | `Document\|ShadowRoot` | Where to add the style tag. Default: document. |
| `opts.selector` | `String` | Selector the properties are set on. Default: ':root', or ':host' if opts.root is a shadow root. |

**Returns:** `Object` - The properties set, keyed by name.

## setFontFaces(host, opts)

Loads the theme fonts from a host using the FontFace API.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `String` | Base URL of the fonts, e.g. '/fonts/cork-theme'. Holds the files copied by `npx cork-theme copy-fonts`. |
| `opts` | `Object` | Options. |
| `opts.fontFaceSet` | `FontFaceSet` | Where to add the faces. Default: document.fonts. |

**Returns:** `FontFace[]` - The faces added. Each loads when the page first uses it.

## copyImages(dest, opts)

Copies the images listed in styles/image-properties.js to a directory, for an app to serve and
pass to setImageCssCustomProperties().

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dest` | `String` | Directory to copy into. Created if needed. |
| `opts` | `Object` | Options. |
| `opts.all` | `Boolean` | Copy the whole images folder instead, for apps that compile the package's Sass themselves (their CSS references every image by relative URL). |

**Returns:** `Promise<String[]>` - Paths of the copied files.

## copyFonts(dest, opts)

Copies the font files listed in styles/font-faces.js (Proxima Nova and Ryman Eco) to a directory,
keeping their relative paths, for an app to serve and pass to setFontFaces().

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dest` | `String` | Directory to copy into. Created if needed. |
| `opts` | `Object` | Options (none yet). |

**Returns:** `Promise<String[]>` - Paths of the copied files.
